image_description: A close-up view of a metallic breastplate (cuirass) resting against a dark red fabric background. The armor is made of polished silver-colored metal with visible hammer marks and reflections. It features brass or bronze edging along the armholes and shoulder straps, secured with rivets. A central vertical ridge runs down the front, and there are attachment points for lower armor sections.
